designs.note: 31110 the clearest single raven; no skull or sketches came in any seed, so sub 'Pen study'. Double frame cropped. Line screened the body into dots, pen kept the feathers. White tees only. fails [], 20.8 x 35.0 cm.

All three suspension-bridge mains were perspective scenes, not elevations. Backup run at 1216x832; 31126 three stone arches between two towers, a landscape plate rather than a bare elevation, so --edge rect and sub 'Side view'. Frame and small caption cropped. White tees. fails [], 26.7 x 18.8 cm.
The water came as a canal between houses, not a harbour, so CANAL TOWN (truth rule). 31131 the densest, no frame, no fake text. --edge horizon. White tees. fails [], 21.8 x 35.3 cm.

31140 a true patent sheet (side view + view from above), drawn dark on light, which line mode prints white on black. Frame, twelve small fake labels and a faint ghost sketch painted to paper. Black tees. fails [], 21.5 x 34.9 cm.

generator_fix: scripts/studio/generate_sdxl.py was OOM-killed at 13.9 GB RSS on the first run (memory cgroup); fixed minimally with malloc_trim after freeing the text encoders and after the UNet upcast, plus attention slicing, run with MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2: peak 12.9 GB, ~265 s an image.
